Current milestone state — updated 2026-06-09.

VERSION: v1.1.1 SHIPPED stable (2026-06-08). v1.1.0 delivered #117 WS1+WS2 (CLI agent parity — JSON envelope, surface-aware instructions, AGENTS.md, `rvr manifest`). v1.1.1 is a parity-completeness patch: #121 unified `rvr init`'s CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md onto a shared core that names BOTH surfaces (prefer MCP, fall back to CLI with identical functionality), and the MCP handshake blob now states CLI parity too. GitHub Release live, 4 binaries. Channels: `rvr` stable (Homebrew seabearDEV/reverie/rvr), `rvr-beta`, `rvr-dev`.

RELEASE PIPELINE HEALTHY: HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN rotated 2026-06-08 and PROVEN by the v1.1.1 run — the "Update Homebrew Tap" job succeeded (v1.1.0's had failed on the expired PAT) and the tap formula auto-bumped to 1.1.1. The fine-grained PAT still expires ≤1yr; the durable deploy-key fix (#123) was considered and CLOSED not-planned — annual manual rotation is acceptable, reopen if it becomes a pain.

LIVE OPEN WORK (issue-tracked, see [[project.tracking]]): #119 WS3 session-state/observability parity, #120 derive JSON envelope from handler return, #124 lower default bootstrap budget (50→38KB), #115 knowledge packs, #84 entry health/staleness (now owns the archived-lifecycle spec that also retires the project.* never-shed carve-out), #13/#43 search (v1.15 theme-candidates). Plus the short-flag audit ([[context.shortFlagAudit]]).

NON-ENGINEERING (not issue-tracked): commercial GTM ([[project.commercialContext]]), launch comms, visual identity.

Shipped-release history lives in the compressed project.* release entries + git history.
